Kwargs.read_bmc_mac_cmd: ipmitool lan print 1 | grep 'MAC Address' | awk '{print$4}' | tr [a-z] [A-Z] | sed 's/://g'
Kwargs.read_lan6_cmd: ipmitool lan6 print 1 | grep -A 1 'DUID' | tail -1 | cut -b 15-26 | tr [a-z] [A-Z]
